description: Handle negated legendary/mythical in the keyless retrieval paths. In sql_retrieval.plan(): 'non legendary', 'non-legendary', 'no legendaries', 'without legendaries', 'not legendary' → legendary=False (and same for mythical); a bare 'legendary' stays True. In matchup.coverage(): accept/apply a legendary/mythical exclusion parsed from the question so 'non-legendary … coverage against dark' stops returning Xerneas/Tapu Lele. Add a small shared helper for negation parsing so Ask and the team recommender agree. No LLM needed.
title: Legendary negation in structured + matchup retrieval
